status: Unavailable-Git snapshot failure passed; bounded case only, not certified

cases.case: Unavailable Git makes the scoped snapshot unavailable without side effects
cases.setup: The existing task had memory save enabled. The snapshot process alone received PATH=<fixture>/operator-evidence/empty-git-path.
cases.expected: The scoped snapshot reports its actual unavailable outcome and a concrete next action, without installation, global PATH change, retry, recovery point, receipt, or completion snapshot.
cases.result: The expanded snapshot command reported that snapshots were unavailable and advised apparatus doctor; the final reported exit 1, no recovery point, the existing saving task retained, and doctor as the concrete next action. A separate task-status read occurred before the scoped snapshot, so the test does not claim literally one total shell command.

limits: Only the scoped snapshot process had an empty PATH; no global PATH behavior was tested.
